f12_resolution.question: Can the 64 governed benchmark outcomes be resolved to per-case identities?
f12_resolution.rule: cognitive_os.learned_observations WHERE source_kind='governed_benchmark_case' AND status='accepted', deduplicated by source_task_id
f12_resolution.quarantined_64: the same 64 case identities under attribution=unknown with no verifier_evidence_hash; one unattributable replay wave, correctly excluded
f12_resolution.consequence: The released denominator reconciles exactly: 214 = 150 enumerated coding outcomes + 64 distinct accepted benchmark cases. The population is 214, not 150, so the S21D1-016 shortfall campaign is not triggered by a missing denominator.
f12_resolution.caveat: All 320 governed_benchmark_case observations carry source_event_id = NULL. They resolve to verifier evidence but not to an ordered pre-outcome event sequence.

e1_5_eligibility_probe.method: read-only SQL SELECT over the enumerated campaign identities; no application service, no held-out metric

decisive_measurement.name: candidate_strategy is a perfect label oracle
decisive_measurement.query: SELECT candidate_strategy, hidden_verification_passed, count(*) FROM the 150 enumerated coding outcome events GROUP BY 1,2
decisive_measurement.interpretation: candidate_strategy determines the independent verifier label with no error on all 150 outcomes. Backlog section 2.2 condition 5 forbids answer-revealing strategy labels, so the field must be excluded. What remains after excluding it is the second half of the finding: every one of the 30 tasks carries the identical 2-of-5 pass pattern, so no surviving pre-outcome feature discriminates between an accepted and a rejected outcome. The surface is not merely leaky, it is information-free once the leak is removed.
decisive_measurement.not_a_defect: This is a property of how the C3 corpus was generated: 30 tasks x 5 fixed strategies, two of which are correct by construction. C3 built it to prove the sandbox and the verifier, and it does that. It was never built to carry a prediction problem.

surface_audits.deterministic_headroom: positional or majority baseline scores 0.5; every task has exactly 4 candidates of which exactly 2 pass
leakage_risks: the identical 2-of-4 split makes group frequency constant
surface_audits.blocking_reason: 120 eligible samples against the 200 threshold of Gate D1 condition 6. It is the only candidate with a genuine 60/60 balance and real content variation between candidates, but 120 + the 50-outcome shortfall cap of section 3.3 reaches 170, still short of 200.

surface_audits.deterministic_headroom: a retrieval surface; relevance is judged by task and group identity, so a single-class balance is expected rather than degenerate
leakage_risks: the query group must be excluded from the candidate pool
correction bytes from the query group must not reach the graph arm
surface_audits.note: 60 historical pairs plus the 20 fresh logic and mathematics pairs of S21D1-030..033 reach the 80-pair graph threshold of section 8.2. This surface is unaffected by the oracle finding.

leakage_risks: candidate_strategy is a measured perfect oracle
final_status, outcome_hash and hidden_evidence_hash are terminal by definition
the 64 benchmark observations have no source_event_id
surface_audits.blocking_reason: 150 coding outcomes are ineligible for no_pre_outcome_feature: the label is a deterministic function of an answer-revealing field, and removing that field leaves nothing that discriminates. 64 benchmark cases are 64/64 passed, a single class, and additionally carry no source event. Gate D1 conditions 6 and 7 both fail.

surface_audits.deterministic_headroom: none; correct_narrow and correct_robust pass on 30 of 30 tasks, so a constant policy is already optimal
leakage_risks: the strategy name is the label
surface_audits.blocking_reason: zero changeable decisions. No learned selection can change an outcome.

primary_threshold_result.status: Gate D1 stays open on the primary surface. No threshold was relaxed to produce a winner.

options_for_s21d1_014.name: correction ranking plus a bounded shortfall campaign
options_for_s21d1_014.effect: Primary becomes experience.correction_ranking. Needs 80 further verifier-backed candidate outcomes to reach 200, which exceeds the 50-outcome cap of section 3.3.
options_for_s21d1_014.requires: an explicit, recorded amendment to the section 3.3 cap, or acceptance of a lower primary threshold
options_for_s21d1_014.gate_impact: condition 6 met only after the amendment

options_for_s21d1_014.name: re-scope the primary surface to new evidence
options_for_s21d1_014.effect: Generate a fresh, deterministic, provider-free outcome population whose label is not a function of a synthetic strategy name, then pre-register on it.
options_for_s21d1_014.requires: materially more than the 50-outcome shortfall cap; effectively a new campaign inside D1
options_for_s21d1_014.gate_impact: section 3.3 explicitly forbids an unbounded campaign inside D1

options_for_s21d1_014.name: declare the primary surface unavailable on frozen C3 evidence
options_for_s21d1_014.effect: D1 proceeds with experience.correction_context as the single pre-registered surface, completes the whole EMG track (waves W3 to W6), and reports the primary-surface finding as a measured negative result.
options_for_s21d1_014.requires: Gate D1 conditions 6 and 7 stay open; the release records why
options_for_s21d1_014.gate_impact: Gate D1 does not pass in full; Gate L2 stays closed either way. D2 receives a proven graph track and an honest statement that C3 evidence does not carry a triage decision problem.
